name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Drones closed Jersey airport two nights running; Romania blames Russia for ship sinking
state: Jersey Airport could not land flights on 30 and 31 Oct after drones were reported near the airfield; police are investigating and no operator has been identified (ITV). Romania blamed Russia after a drone sank a ship in the Black Sea on 23 Oct. No casualties from sabotage on land have been reported.
for_you: Drone sightings can cause short-notice flight delays and diversions. Check with your airline before travelling.
rubric_hit: Drone incursions closed an airport; attack attributed to a state

sources.title: ITV News — Jersey airspace closed for second night after reported drone sighting
Al Jazeera — Romania blames Russia after drone sinks ship in the Black Sea

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
